Ekans

Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Ekans is a Poison-type Snake Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 2 m tall and weighs 6.9 kg. It evolves into Arbok. Its highest base stat is Attack (60), with a base stat total of 288.
